---
title: Ground Truth Infrastructure
---

## The problem
Remote sensing and incident databases report events roughly 14 days after they occur. These resources cannot capture the shifting needs and threats communities face in real-time. In conflict-affected or underconnected areas, the most salient operational information never makes it into those databases at all.

## What I do
I deploy and configure a lightweight SMS-based field 
reporting system that collects structured reports from community members and surfaces them as a real-time geographic dashboard. No smartphones or internet required on the reporting end.

## What you get
A pilot deployment for one organization, one geography, over an agreed time window (typically 3–6 months), including system configuration, reporting schema design with your team, and a web-based map dashboard. Expansion to additional geographies or use 
cases is scoped after pilot completion.

## Proof
[Technical overview and demo (GitHub)](https://github.com/tklustner/sms-mapper-overview.git)
Prototype demonstrated at a civil society technology 
conference in San Cristóbal de las Casas, Chiapas. Active pilot in development with PATH Zambia.
